raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in its analysis of the WebSurfer's output. While the WebSurfer correctly identified the search result showing "Roud no: 821" for the title "WHAT ARE LITTLE GIRLS MADE OF" on the VWML page, the Planner incorrectly transcribed this number as "822" in its "Updated Understanding" and subsequent final answer. This hallucination of the digit (changing 1 to 2) led to the provision of the wrong Roud Folk Song Index number.
